name: Seekh Kebab
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine minced mutton with ginger-garlic paste, onions, spices, lemon juice, and roasted gram flour.
2. Knead the mixture thoroughly until it becomes smooth and holds its shape.
3. Grease your palms and take a portion of the mixture, pressing it firmly onto a metal skewer to form a long cylindrical shape.
4. Heat a tandoor or a grill pan and brush with ghee.
5. Cook the kebabs, rotating them frequently until they turn golden brown and develop a slight char.
6. Serve hot with mint chutney, onion rings, and lemon wedges.
description: While the Seekh Kebab has roots in Mughlai cuisine, it is a beloved staple in the culinary landscape of Madhya Pradesh, especially in cities like Bhopal. Influenced by the state's royal heritage, these kebabs are celebrated for their melt-in-the-mouth texture and the balanced infusion of local earthy spices.
